claims.confidence: high for observed request channel; medium for monetization
claims.statement: The Commission recommends VSME so SMEs can answer sustainability-information requests from large customers and financial institutions and potentially improve access to sustainable finance.
The Commission recommendation explicitly explores e-invoicing extraction for VSME reporting, supporting an accounting-data automation wedge.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: SME owner/CFO, accountant or lender supplier-finance team
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Evidence-backed answers generated from Polish accounting and energy documents; accounting suites and banks can bundle
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business through SME subscriptions or accountant channel contracts
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Accounting firms, banks, leasing brokers and renewable installers

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 500-2,000 PLN per SME through accountants
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Annual subscription prepaid or accountant bulk billing
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 75-88% after document processing and support
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Onboarding, document QA and annual report review
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Security, accounting integrations, legal updates and insurance
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Annual company passport subscription plus lender/customer export packs
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: OCR/model calls, energy-data connectors and accountant review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Banks, accounting software and ESG platforms provide free VSME forms
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A lender or large customer requests sustainability information, delaying finance or supplier onboarding when evidence is missing
commercial_mechanics.payer: SME, accounting firm, lender or supply-chain sponsor
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Loan application, tender, customer questionnaire or annual reporting cycle
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual VSME refresh and each finance/tender request

contrary_evidence: VSME is voluntary and designed to reduce burden, limiting price.
Free templates may satisfy many microbusinesses.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: No customer access held; proposed data-processing and accountant distribution agreements
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Sell direct to SMEs or through another accountant/bank
critical_control_point.current_owner: SMEs own evidence; accountants, banks and customers control request channels
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business through SME subscriptions or accountant channel contracts
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Parents' company may voluntarily serve as a design partner with explicit consent; no records or rights are assumed
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Prospective business after customer consent and integrations
critical_control_point.subject: Reusable VSME evidence passport generated from operating records

economics.acquisition_route: Build a consented design-partner report for one SME, sell via two accounting firms, then add standardized evidence imports
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 5,000 SMEs at 2,400 PLN ARR and 22% EBITDA produces 2.64m PLN EBITDA; at 4-6x founder value exceeds 5m PLN in years 7-10. Channel conversion and ARPU are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours weekly; accountant channel lowers support load
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription less document processing, support and channel commission
economics.payback: Assumption: 60-100 SMEs recover product cost within 18 months
economics.pricing: Assumption: 1,200-4,800 PLN yearly per SME; bulk channel discounts
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual refresh plus recurring lender/customer exports

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Reusable evidence ledger and benchmarked questionnaire mappings
fingerprint.customer: Polish SMEs receiving finance or supply-chain data requests
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: SME or sponsor pays when finance/tender requests require answers
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Sustainability questionnaires arrive without reusable evidence

founder_fit: Can validate in a consented family-business setting.
Low capital and low public exposure.

structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: accountants lenders and supply chain sponsors

thesis: Future state: SMEs answer lender and customer sustainability requests from a reusable evidence record. The missing coordination mechanism is an accounting-linked VSME passport that converts operating documents into verifiable answers.
title: VSME Finance-and-Supplier Passport
